verdict.rationale: Inline commenting on specific text or images in an item's description is a fair question for a project-management tool like Shortcut, but the evidence pack never documents it. The closest item is Docs Suggestion Mode, which lets Doc collaborators see proposed changes. That is a different feature (suggested edits on Docs, not inline comments on item descriptions), so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can comment directly on specific text or images within an item's description
